The provision allowing a split of one-third of a legislature party was removed
questions.why: The 91st Amendment removed the one-third split exception, so only a merger of two-thirds of the legislature party protects members from disqualification.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: In Kihoto Hollohan v. Zachillhu (1992) the Supreme Court held that
opts: the Tenth Schedule is invalid because it violates the freedom of speech of legislators
the Speaker’s decision on disqualification is final and cannot be questioned in any court
the decision of the Speaker on disqualification is subject to judicial review
the Election Commission alone is empowered to decide on all disqualification petitions
questions.why: The Court upheld the Tenth Schedule but held that the Speaker’s decision is open to judicial review on limited grounds.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the India–Nepal Joint Vision announced in November 2026:
1. India announced a development cooperation package of ₹15,000 crore for Nepal.
2. Kandla and Paradip were added as ports for Nepal’s transit cargo.
3. The 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship was terminated with immediate effect.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: The package and the additional ports were announced. The 1950 Treaty is to be reviewed by mutual consent; it was not terminated.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q: The motorable bridge between Dharchula in India and Darchula in Nepal is built over which river?
questions.why: The Mahakali, known as the Sharda in India, forms part of the India–Nepal boundary in this section.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, consider the following statements:
1. India became a full member in 2017.
2. Iran became a member in 2023.
3. Its secretariat is located in Moscow.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: India joined in 2017 and Iran in 2023. The SCO Secretariat is in Beijing.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q: The first Civilisational Dialogue Forum of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, held in November 2026, adopted a document known as the
questions.why: The forum at Purana Qila, New Delhi adopted the Indraprastha Communiqué on cultural cooperation and shared heritage.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to securitisation of loans, consider the following statements:
1. A lender sells a pool of loans to a special purpose vehicle that issues securities backed by the repayments.
2. It helps lenders free capital for fresh lending.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Both are correct. Securitisation converts a pool of loans into tradable securities and frees capital for new credit.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under the Reserve Bank’s final securitisation amendments issued in November 2026, a minimum ticket size per investor is fixed at
questions.why: A minimum ticket size of ₹1 crore applies at issue and on transfer, and covered notes must be held in dematerialised form from 1 April 2027.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: A feature proposed in the Reserve Bank’s draft rules on electronic payment safeguards that blocks outward debits from an account while allowing credits to continue is called a
questions.why: The Stop Switch blocks outward debits while inward credits continue, giving customers a quick way to protect an account.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: The Green India Mission is one of the missions under which of the following?
opts: National Clean Energy Mission and Innovation Fund
Namami Gange Programme for rivers and wetlands
National Action Plan on Climate Change
questions.why: The Green India Mission is one of the eight missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (2008).

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: India’s Nationally Determined Contribution includes creating an additional carbon sink of how much by 2030?
opts: 1 to 1.5 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent
2.5 to 3 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent
5 to 6 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent
8 to 10 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent
questions.why: India pledged an additional carbon sink of 2.5 to 3 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent through additional forest and tree cover by 2030.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the dugong:
1. It is a marine mammal that feeds mainly on seagrass.
2. India’s first Dugong Conservation Reserve was declared in Palk Bay.
3. It is listed in Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Palk Bay Dugong Conservation Reserve in Tamil Nadu was declared in 2022.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Mass nesting of olive ridley turtles on a beach is known as
questions.why: Arribada is the Spanish word for arrival and describes mass nesting, as seen on the Odisha coast.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Which one of the following best describes ‘Just Transition’ in climate negotiations?
opts: Support for workers and regions dependent on fossil fuels as the economy shifts to clean energy
A transfer of clean energy technology free of cost to every developing country that formally asks for it
A global fund that pays for the permanent loss of coastal land when the sea level rises over time
A carbon tax that is charged at the border on all goods imported from every country in the world
questions.why: Just Transition covers training, jobs and support for people and places that depend on fossil fuels.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Decisions at the Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC are generally taken by
questions.why: COP decisions are taken by consensus, so objection by even one Party can block a text.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: The joint ISRO–CNES satellite mission TRISHNA is intended for
opts: thermal infrared observation of land and water surfaces
deep space observation of distant galaxies and black holes in the universe
navigation and timing signals for aircraft, ships and ground vehicles
communication links for remote villages and mountain regions of the country
questions.why: TRISHNA is a thermal infrared Earth observation mission for water and land surface monitoring, planned in a sun-synchronous orbit.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: Which of the following is a joint India–France satellite mission to study the tropical water cycle?
questions.why: Megha-Tropiques (2011) studied the tropical water cycle. SARAL-AltiKa (2013) is a joint ocean altimetry satellite.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: A bacteriophage is a
questions.why: A bacteriophage is a virus that infects bacteria and is used in phage therapy.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
Consider the following statements about genome language models:
1. They are trained on DNA sequences and learn patterns in them.
2. They can be used to predict the effect of mutations.
3. They pose no biosafety or biosecurity concerns.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: Such models learn from DNA and predict mutation effects, but they raise dual-use concerns, so statement 3 is wrong.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: Indirect calorimetry, as used in a human metabolic chamber, estimates energy expenditure by measuring
opts: body temperature and heart rate measured together over a day
oxygen consumed and carbon dioxide produced
weight gained over a week of regular eating and rest
blood sugar and insulin levels measured after every meal
questions.why: Energy use is inferred from the oxygen a person consumes and the carbon dioxide produced.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The National Industrial Classification (NIC) is used to
opts: classify banks by the size of their assets and deposits
rank the states by their level of industrial output each year
set import duties on industrial goods brought from other countries
group economic activities for statistical purposes
questions.why: NIC is the standard classification of economic activities. The 2026 survey of unincorporated enterprises uses NIC 2025.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Which one of the following is excluded from the coverage of the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises?
questions.why: Construction is outside the coverage of the survey of non-agricultural unincorporated enterprises.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: Anaemia Mukt Bharat, launched in 2018, aims to reduce anaemia among
opts: children below five years of age in rural areas only
pregnant and lactating women in urban areas only
elderly persons living alone in all districts
questions.why: The programme targets children, adolescents and women, using supplements, deworming, testing and diet measures.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: Which of the following is a marker of the body’s iron stores that is measured in nutrition surveys?
questions.why: Ferritin reflects iron stores in the body and is adjusted for inflammation in nutrition surveys.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Under the Mining Plan and Mine Closure Guidelines 2026 for coal, an operator must
opts: pay the entire closure cost to the State government in advance at the time of lease grant
complete all restoration work before production from the mine is allowed to begin
hand over the mined-out land to the local municipality free of any conditions
open a closure escrow account in a scheduled commercial bank and deposit money each year
questions.why: The guidelines require an escrow account with annual deposits, and withdrawals are checked by the Coal Controller.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Underground coal gasification refers to
opts: washing coal in water to reduce its ash content before sale
crushing coal into fine powder before it is burnt in boilers
converting coal in place into gas that is brought to the surface
storing coal underground in sealed chambers as a national reserve
questions.why: In underground coal gasification the coal seam is burnt in place and the gas produced is brought to the surface.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q: Which one of the following is an EU measure that charges carbon-intensive imports?
questions.why: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism puts a carbon price on imports of selected carbon-intensive goods and is a concern in India–EU trade talks.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q: Negotiations for the India–European Union free trade agreement were concluded on
questions.why: The negotiations were concluded on 27 January 2026, with signing expected in December 2026.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under the monetary policy framework of India, the inflation target is
opts: 6% with a tolerance band of plus or minus 2%
3% with a tolerance band of plus or minus 3%
5% with a tolerance band of plus or minus 1.5%
4% with a tolerance band of plus or minus 2%
questions.why: The target is 4% with a band of 2% to 6%. If inflation stays outside the band for three consecutive quarters, the Reserve Bank must report to the government.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. An increase in the repo rate makes bank credit costlier.
2. The repo rate is the rate at which the Reserve Bank borrows from banks.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: A higher repo rate makes credit costlier. The repo rate is the rate at which the Reserve Bank lends to banks; the rate at which it borrows is the reverse repo rate.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: Which one of the following festivals is observed on Karthika Purnima?
questions.why: Guru Nanak Jayanti, the birth anniversary of the first Sikh Guru, falls on Karthika Purnima, which was 24 November in 2026.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: Guru Tegh Bahadur, whose martyrdom day is observed on 24 November, was the
opts: tenth Sikh Guru, killed at Chamkaur in 1705
fifth Sikh Guru, who compiled the Adi Granth
ninth Sikh Guru, executed in Delhi in 1675
seventh Sikh Guru, who defended Amritsar against Mughal forces
questions.why: Guru Tegh Bahadur was the ninth Guru and was executed in Delhi in 1675 for defending freedom of belief.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: The Sikh practice of community kitchen that serves free meals to all without distinction is called
questions.why: Langar is the community kitchen, started by Guru Nanak and expanded by later Gurus.
